title: First Bath
desc: Splashes, wide eyes, and a very cautious pair of parents — your first bath was an adventure for all of us.
story: Your Maami held you gently in the bathroom sink while Mum slowly and carefully gave you your very first bath. Dad was far too scared to get involved — he stood back and watched with wide eyes, heart in his mouth. You cried and cried, and all of our hearts were beating very fast. But the moment we wrapped you up snug and warm in your towel, you finally settled down. Just like that, the crying stopped and peace returned. It was quite the adventure — and one we will never forget.
